nodes.description: bytes32 public merkleRoot; root of the allow-list merkle tree used to verify claimants in claimRing.
address public rings; address of the ERC721 collection whose rings are distributed.
bool public paused; global pause flag checked at the start of claimRing.
mapping(address => bool) public claimed; per-address one-shot claim guard keyed by msg.sender.
address private _owner (Ownable); the privileged account controlling setters and the tokenOwner requirement.

public claimRing(bytes32[] proof, uint256 tokenId); permissionless claim that checks pause state, one-shot claim, token ownership against owner(), a merkle proof over msg.sender, then transfers the NFT.
public onlyOwner setMerkleRoot(bytes32 root); overwrites the merkle root.
public onlyOwner setRings(address _rings); repoints the NFT collection address used by claimRing.
public onlyOwner setPaused(bool _paused); toggles the claim pause flag.
public view owner() (Ownable); returns _owner and is used as the required holder of the ring in claimRing.
constructor(bytes32 _root, address _rings) initializing merkleRoot and rings.
Ownable modifier onlyOwner; requires owner() == _msgSender() before executing the guarded setter.
Caller-controlled address; key of the claimed mapping, merkle leaf and recipient of the NFT in claimRing.
External call IERC721(rings).transferFrom(tokenOwner, msg.sender, tokenId); executes attacker-influenced external code on the rings contract.
bytes32[] memory proof; caller-supplied merkle proof passed to MerkleProof.verify.
uint256 tokenId; caller-supplied ring id used for ownerOf and transferFrom.
bytes32 root; new merkle root argument of setMerkleRoot.
address _rings; new rings contract address argument of setRings.
bool _paused; new pause value argument of setPaused.
bytes32 _root; constructor argument assigned to merkleRoot.
address _rings; constructor argument assigned to rings.
address tokenOwner; local holding IERC721(rings).ownerOf(tokenId) result in claimRing.
External view call IERC721(rings).ownerOf(tokenId); reads state from the externally-controlled rings contract before any state update.

edges.reason: msg.sender is read by claimRing for the claimed mapping, merkle leaf and transfer recipient.
claimRing writes claimed[msg.sender] = true, mutating state keyed by the caller.
claimRing reads merkleRoot when calling MerkleProof.verify.
claimRing reads rings to build the IERC721 interface for ownerOf and transferFrom.
claimRing reads paused in the require(!paused) guard.
claimRing reads and writes the claimed mapping for the one-shot claim guard.
claimRing calls owner() to compare against tokenOwner before allowing the claim.
claimRing performs an external ERC721 transferFrom call, an attacker-reachable external interaction.
claimRing performs an external ownerOf call on the rings contract before any state update.
The rings state variable supplies the callee address for the ownerOf external call.
setMerkleRoot writes the merkleRoot state variable.
setRings writes the rings state variable.
setPaused writes the paused state variable.
onlyOwner gates setMerkleRoot, restricting merkle root changes to the owner.
onlyOwner gates setRings, restricting repointing of the NFT contract to the owner.
onlyOwner gates setPaused, restricting pause control to the owner.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender(), i.e. the caller-controlled msg.sender value.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
The constructor assigns _root to merkleRoot.
The constructor assigns _rings to rings.
The proof parameter flows into claimRing's MerkleProof.verify call.
The tokenId parameter flows into claimRing's ownership check and transfer.
The root parameter is assigned to merkleRoot in setMerkleRoot.
The _rings parameter is assigned to the rings state variable in setRings.
The _paused parameter is assigned to the paused state variable in setPaused.
The constructor _root parameter is stored into merkleRoot.
The constructor _rings parameter is stored into rings.
The tokenOwner local is assigned and compared inside claimRing.
tokenId is passed as the token argument of the external transferFrom call.
The tokenOwner local is passed as the from argument of the external transferFrom call.
msg.sender is passed as the to argument of the external transferFrom call.

tokenId is only used inside claimRing for ownerOf and transferFrom and carries no standalone semantics.
The root parameter is a direct argument of setMerkleRoot and merges into it.
The _rings parameter is a direct argument of setRings and merges into it.
The _paused parameter is a direct argument of setPaused and merges into it.
The _root constructor argument is written into merkleRoot and merges into the constructor node.
The _rings constructor argument is written into rings and merges into the constructor node.
tokenOwner is the source address supplied to the external transferFrom call and merges into that unsafe operation.
